proposed_sector.name: AI & Machine Learning
proposed_sector.blurb: The newest field on this board and the fastest moving. A few seats need a computer science degree. Most of them need one language, one project you can explain, and a business head.
proposed_sector.typical: Computer Science and Data Science for the model building. Business Data Analytics, CIS, Finance, Accountancy and Management for the product, risk, audit and adoption work, which is the larger half of the hiring.
proposed_sector.quizResult: Your answers point at AI and machine learning. You went toward the problem nobody has a template for yet, you are willing to learn a tool properly rather than talk about it, and you would rather be early to something unfinished than late to something settled. Read the field honestly before you commit: the roles that say machine learning engineer want a real quantitative background, and the roles that say AI product, AI risk or AI governance want somebody who can hold a room and read a contract. Both are on this list. Only one of them is being fought over by every CS student at Fulton.
steps: Build one thing with an API and put it somewhere a stranger can use it. A recruiter can open that in thirty seconds, and almost nobody applying to these roles has one.
Decide which half you are going for before you write a resume. Say model, say pipeline, or say governance. All three are hiring and they screen for different people.
Apply in September. Most of the Summer 2027 requisitions here opened in August and several close in the last week of September, before the ASU career fairs have even finished.

roles.note: The strongest AI internship in the metro, and it is not in New York. Amex builds its AI in Phoenix, so the same search returns a wall of senior agentic AI reqs sitting in the office you would be sitting in.
roles.evidence: Rendered Oracle board, 59 results, listing Campus Undergraduate Summer Internship Program - 2027 AI Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services- Phoenix, AZ posted 08/17/2026. Page title Search Jobs - American Express Careers.

roles.role: Campus Undergraduate Summer Internship, 2027 Data Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services

roles.evidence: Rendered Oracle board, 17 results, listing 2027 Data Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services- Phoenix, AZ posted 09/01/2026.

roles.role: Campus Undergraduate Summer Internship, 2027 Data Analytics, Enterprise Technology Services

roles.note: This is the full-time version of the Summer Scholar seat and it is the honest option for a senior who never got the internship. It wants prior internship or project work in analytics or software, not just the degree.

notes_for_integration: Already on the board, so add these roles to the existing employer card rather than creating a second one: American Express, Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG, Honeywell, Intel, Charles Schwab, Northern Trust. Nine of the thirteen employers here are repeats. Only Axon, NVIDIA, Arizona State University and Anthropic would be new cards. Note that the existing cards carry sector keys accounting, consulting, finance and tech, and the role-level sector override already used on Freeport and Intel rows is the clean way to file an individual AI role under the new key without moving the whole employer. Twenty-five of the thirty-three roles here are open to business majors. Rejected and why: Carvana, which has a real Tempe data science team but whose careers site and Greenhouse mirror both sit behind Cloudflare and returned 403 to every request, with no Summer 2027 intern requisition live on the API today. Nextiva, whose Scottsdale AI engineering internship appears in search results but is not on its live Greenhouse board, which currently shows one intern role and it is in Bengaluru. Amazon and Microsoft, whose university pages verify fine but which have no US Summer 2027 AI or ML internship posted yet, only Melbourne, Tokyo and London requisitions. Palantir, whose students page renders entirely in JavaScript and exposes no job listing a link could point at. Wells Fargo and USAA, both of which blocked every request. TSMC Arizona, onsemi and Microchip, which are already on the board under engineering and have no AI-titled intern requisition between them. Republic Services and Freeport-McMoRan, both already on the board, whose job boards render client-side and returned no AI or data science intern requisition. Two deadlines are urgent enough to matter this week: the Schwab Corporate Risk Management intern and the Intel AI Solutions Engineering intern both close 16 September 2026, and all three PwC roles close 26 September 2026. One correction worth carrying into the copy: EY, PwC and KPMG all describe AI-heavy work, but none of the three has an AI-titled internship, and outside of the EY Phoenix Data and Intelligence Delivery seat none of their AI-adjacent 2027 requisitions lists Arizona at all. The Phoenix AI story on this board is American Express first, Intel second, and everything else is a summer away.
